description: This module allows to add and remove badges to/from a project.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: image_url
parameters.description: The image URL of the badge. A badge is identified by this URL.

parameters.name: link_url
parameters.description: The URL associated with the badge.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name (or full path) of the GitLab project the badge is added to/removed from.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the badge in the project. On present, it adds a badge to a GitLab project. On absent, it removes a badge from a GitLab project. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Add a badge to a GitLab Project
  community.general.gitlab_project_badge:
    api_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com'
    api_token: 'Your-Private-Token'
    project: projectname
    state: present
    link_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com/%{project_path}'
    image_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com/%{project_path}/badges/%{default_branch}/pipeline.svg'

- name: Remove a badge from a GitLab Project
  community.general.gitlab_project_badge:
    api_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com'
    api_token: 'Your-Private-Token'
    project: projectname
    state: absent
    link_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com/%{project_path}'
    image_url: 'https://example.gitlab.com/%{project_path}/badges/%{default_branch}/pipeline.svg'

return_values.name: badge
return_values.description: The badge information. Returned: when state=present Sample: {"id": 1, "image_url": "https://shields.io/my/badge", "kind": "project", "link_url": "http://example.com/ci_status.svg?project=%{project_path}&ref=%{default_branch}", "rendered_image_url": "https://shields.io/my/badge", "rendered_link_url": "http://example.com/ci_status.svg?project=example-org/example-project&ref=master"}
